raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
**Problem.** For RL, the client sends the prompt as token IDs so the engine runs exactly what the trainer will score. Two bugs break this for requests with images. 1. On the chat endpoint, a request sent as token IDs loses its images. The model answers a prompt whose image placeholders stand for nothing. 2. To find the images, the server turns the IDs back into text and searches for placeholder strings. Text that only spells a placeholder (for example `` in HTML the model wrote) counts as one more image, and the request fails with HTTP 500. In our RL runs that cost 3 episodes in the first hour. Example 1. Both bugs on one request, before and after, Qwen3.8-27B-VL. ```text bug 1, token IDs: 21 IDs with 1 placeholder, plus 1 image (1024x576 = 576 image tokens) now: images dropped -> the engine runs 21 IDs, text only fixed: the engine runs 20 + 576 = 596 IDs, ID for ID bug 2, prompt: 1 screenshot + an earlier reply with "
" now: 2 placeholders found, 1 image given -> HTTP 500 fixed: 1 placeholder ID = 1 image; "" stays text -> HTTP 200 ``` **Where in the code.** - Bug 1. The chat endpoint drops the images when token IDs are set: [`serving_chat.py:1454-1463`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_chat.py#L1454-L1463). The token-ID path came in [sglang#23751](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/23751). - Bug 2. The loaders decode the IDs and split the text with a regex: [`base_processor.py:1256-1265`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/base_processor.py#L1256-L1265) (`load_mm_data`) and [`base_processor.py:1429-1438`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/base_processor.py#L1429-L1438) (`legacy_load_mm_data`). - Bug 2. The Qwen VL regex, which also matches ``: [`qwen_vl.py:401-403`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/qwen_vl.py#L401-L403). - Bug 2. The error on one extra match: [`base_processor.py:1120-1122`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/base_processor.py#L1120-L1122). - Expansion of one placeholder per image, from [sglang#26555](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/26555): [`base_processor.py:1852-1858`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/base_processor.py#L1852-L1858). **Change.** - Bug 1. When a multimodal model gets a request with token IDs, the chat endpoint collects the images, videos and audio from the messages, as the template path does, and passes them with the IDs. Text-only models and requests without IDs are unchanged. - Bug 2. The fix skips the decode-and-search step for ID prompts. It finds images by counting the placeholder ID, which already sits in the list. That's simpler, and it can't be fooled by text, because typed text never produces the placeholder ID. Each image is one placeholder ID, or one run of them if the client already expanded it; any other count is a 400. The engine then runs the client's IDs as sent, with each placeholder expanded to its image's tokens by the existing exact-token code ([sglang#26555](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/26555)). If expansion fails, the request fails instead of quietly re-tokenizing. Requests sent as text, requests with video, audio or precomputed features, and requests with `SGLANG_MM_AVOID_RETOKENIZE` off keep the old path. Example 2. Bug 2 on one request with 1 screenshot, before and after. Qwen3.8-27B-VL; the placeholder `<|image_pad|>` is ID 248056, and the text `
` tokenizes to `[2539, 1721, 1742, 1419, 596, 29]`. ```text BEFORE IDs: [... 20 text IDs ..., 248056, ..., 2539, 1721, 1742, 1419, 596, 29, ...] + 1 image │ ├─ decode IDs to text ──► "...<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|> ...
..." ├─ regex split on <|vision_start|><|image_pad|>+<|vision_end|> or └─ 2 markers found, 1 image attached ──► "More 'IMAGE' tokens found" ──► HTTP 500 AFTER IDs: same + 1 image │ ├─ count ID 248056 in the IDs ──► 1 ("" is the text IDs 1742, 1419, 596, never 248056) ├─ 1 placeholder, 1 image ──► match └─ keep the IDs; expand 248056 to the image's 576 tokens ──► engine runs the IDs as sent ──► HTTP 200 ``` Diff 1. The core of each part: [`serving_chat.py`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_chat.py#L1454-L1463) (bug 1) and [`base_processor.py`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/7dc2930585782c09630d617a510bec08c1724845/python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/base_processor.py#L1230) (bug 2). ```diff # serving_chat.py, _process_messages, input_ids branch + image_data, video_data, audio_data, modalities = ( + self._collect_media_for_pretokenized(request) if is_multimodal else ([], [], [], []) + ) - image_data=None, + image_data=image_data if image_data else None, # base_processor.py, load_mm_data and legacy_load_mm_data + ids_for_media = self._ids_for_media(prompt, input_ids, multimodal_tokens, image_data, video_data, audio_data) + if ids_for_media is not None and envs.SGLANG_MM_AVOID_RETOKENIZE.get() and not self.preserve_processor_input_ids: + return await self._load_mm_data_by_ids(ids_for_media, multimodal_tokens, image_data, discard_alpha_channel) ``` **Model scope.** Bug 1: all VLMs (generic chat endpoint). Bug 2: all VLMs that use SGLang's shared loaders; tested on Qwen3.8 and GLM-5.3. **Tests.** 9 new tests. All pass. ```bash pytest test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py test/registered/vlm/test_chat_input_ids_keeps_images_e2e.py test/unit/multimodal/test_load_mm_data_by_ids.py ``` Chat endpoint with token IDs (unit, and end to end on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct): - A request with token IDs on a multimodal model keeps its images; on a text-only model it carries none. - "D" + "escribe" + one placeholder + one 64x64 image through `/v1/chat/completions` runs as `len(input_ids) - 1 + N` prompt tokens, the same count as `/generate` for the same IDs and image. - The same text without the image keeps `len(input_ids)` prompt tokens. Loaders on an ID prompt: - One ID per image is read first; a run of placeholder IDs counts as one image. - Both loaders run an ID prompt with a tokenizer whose `decode()` raises, so the decoded text is never produced. - 2 placeholders with 1 image is a client error (`ValueError`), not a 500. - With `SGLANG_MM_AVOID_RETOKENIZE` off, an ID prompt keeps the text path. - Text prompts, video, audio and precomputed features keep the text path. **Results on a real model.** Table 1. Requests with images sent as token IDs, Qwen3.8-27B-VL and a 4-layer GLM-5.3 model. | Model | Request | Before | After | |---|---|---|---| | Qwen3.8-27B-VL | 21 IDs, 1 placeholder, 1 image, chat endpoint | 21 IDs run, image dropped | 596 IDs run, ID for ID | | Qwen3.8-27B-VL | 2 images plus the vision markers spelled with ordinary tokens | HTTP 500 | HTTP 200, 315 prompt tokens, IDs as sent | | Qwen3.8-27B-VL | 2 images plus the lone pad string as text | HTTP 500 | HTTP 200, 303 prompt tokens, IDs as sent | | Qwen3.8-27B-VL | 2 images plus `` in HTML | not measured | HTTP 200, 313 prompt tokens, IDs as sent | | Qwen3.8-27B-VL | 2 placeholders, 1 image | not measured | HTTP 400 | | GLM-5.3, 4 layers | marker form, `` text, expanded form | not measured | HTTP 200, IDs as sent | | GLM-5.3, 4 layers | placeholder count differs from images | not measured | HTTP 400 | All Qwen rows ran through both `/generate` and `/v1/chat/completions`. 8 agent episodes through the miles session server (1,136 requests) all ran ID for ID, with 0 "falling back to decode+retokenize" lines. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

+    def _collect_media_for_pretokenized(self, request: ChatCompletionRequest):
+        """The images, videos and audio of a request whose prompt arrives as
+        ``input_ids``: the same extraction the template path runs, without
+        rendering. The client's ids carry one placeholder per item."""
+        image_data: List[Any] = []
+        video_data: List[Any] = []
+        audio_data: List[Any] = []
+        modalities: List[str] = []
+        for message in request.messages:
+            msg_dict = message.model_dump()

         return is_precomputed, images, videos, audios
 
+    # Images of a pre-tokenized prompt are located by the
+    # placeholder id in the ids; the decoded text is never scanned.
+    @staticmethod
+    def _ids_for_media(
+        prompt, input_ids, multimodal_tokens, image_data, video_data, audio_data
+    ):
+        """The prompt's token ids when its images are to be located by id:
+        the prompt arrived as ids, the request carries images (none of them
+        precomputed) and no video or audio, and the processor knows its
+        image placeholder id and token. Else None, and the text path runs."""
+        ids = (
+            input_ids
+            if input_ids is not None
+            else (prompt if isinstance(prompt, list) else None)
+        )
+        if ids is None or not image_data or video_data or audio_data:
+            return None
+        if any(isinstance(item, dict) for item in image_data):
+            return None
+        if (
+            multimodal_tokens.image_token_id is None
+            or not multimodal_tokens.image_token
+        ):
+            return None
+        return ids.tolist() if hasattr(ids, "tolist") else list(ids)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _placeholder_runs(input_ids, token_id):
+        """Runs of consecutive ``token_id`` in the ids."""
+        runs = 0
+        previous = None
+        for token in input_ids:
+            if token == token_id and previous != token_id:
+                runs += 1
+            previous = token
+        return runs
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _collapse_placeholder_runs(input_ids, token_id):
+        """``input_ids`` with every run of ``token_id`` reduced to one id,
+        the form ``_expand_input_ids`` expands."""
+        out = []
+        previous = None
+        for token in input_ids:
+            if token == token_id and previous == token_id:
+                continue
+            out.append(token)
+            previous = token
+        return out
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _placeholder_layout(cls, input_ids, token_id, n_images):
+        """The ids with one placeholder id per image. One id per image is the
+        wire form (the count of ids equals the images, adjacent ids allowed:
+        a GLM prompt has no marker between two images); else each run of
+        the id is one expanded image and is collapsed; else the request is a
+        client error."""
+        singles = sum(1 for token in input_ids if token == token_id)
+        if singles == n_images:
+            return list(input_ids)
+        runs = cls._placeholder_runs(input_ids, token_id)
+        if runs == n_images:
+            return cls._collapse_placeholder_runs(input_ids, token_id)
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"prompt ids carry {singles} image placeholder id(s) in {runs} run(s) but "
+            f"{n_images} image(s) were provided"
+        )
+
+    async def _load_mm_data_by_ids(
+        self, input_ids, multimodal_tokens, image_data, discard_alpha_channel=True
+    ):
+        """Images of a pre-tokenized prompt, located by the image placeholder
+        id in the ids. The HF processor receives a synthetic text of one
+        image token per image (it only counts and expands them; the request
+        ids are the prompt), the images in request order, and the ids with
+        one placeholder id per image, which ``process_and_combine_mm_data``
+        expands in place. Ordinary tokens that spell an image token stay
+        text. The output is marked ``synthetic_text``: its text is not a
+        prompt, so a failed expansion must raise, never fall back to it."""
+        token_id = multimodal_tokens.image_token_id
+        ids = self._placeholder_layout(input_ids, token_id, len(image_data))
+        image_token = multimodal_tokens.image_token
+        if isinstance(image_token, list):
+            image_token = image_token[0]
+        output = await self.fast_load_mm_data(
+            prompt=image_token * len(image_data),
+            multimodal_tokens=multimodal_tokens,
+            image_data=image_data,
+            discard_alpha_channel=discard_alpha_channel,
+            input_ids=ids,
+        )
+        output.synthetic_text = True
+        return output
+

         prompt: str,
@@ -1253,6 +1347,19 @@ async def load_mm_data(

+            and not self.preserve_processor_input_ids
+        ):
+            return await self._load_mm_data_by_ids(

+            )

+"""E2E test: /v1/chat/completions with ``input_ids`` keeps the images.
+
+A pre-tokenized client (the miles TITO session server) sends the prompt as
+``input_ids`` with one image placeholder per image, plus the messages that
+carry the images. Before this change the chat endpoint dropped the images
+whenever ``input_ids`` was set (``image_data=None``), so the model never saw
+the screenshot. Now the images reach the multimodal processor, which expands
+each placeholder in place and keeps every other id verbatim
+(SGLANG_MM_AVOID_RETOKENIZE, test_token_id_retokenize_e2e.py).
+
+The check: for one non-canonical prompt ("Describe" split into "D" +
+"escribe") plus one image, the chat endpoint's ``usage.prompt_tokens`` equals
+the ``/generate`` path's ``prompt_tokens`` for the same ids and image, and
+both equal ``len(input_ids) - 1 + N`` where N is the processor's token count
+for the image. A text-only prompt through the chat endpoint stays at
+``len(input_ids)``.
+"""
+
+import base64
+import io
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+from PIL import Image
+from transformers import AutoProcessor
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=200, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+IMAGE_SIZE = (64, 64)
+
+
+def _data_uri():
+    img = Image.new("RGB", IMAGE_SIZE, (128, 128, 128))
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    img.save(buf, format="PNG")
+    return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+
+
+def _build_prompt(model, image_token):
+    """A non-canonical prompt ("D" + "escribe" re-encodes to one token) with
+    one image placeholder, and the processor's expanded token count for the
+    image."""
+    processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(model, trust_remote_code=True)
+    tok = processor.tokenizer
+
+    def enc(text):
+        return tok.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
+
+    input_ids = enc("D") + enc("escribe") + enc(" the picture: ") + enc(image_token)
+    image_tokens = int(
+        processor._get_num_multimodal_tokens(
+            image_sizes=[(IMAGE_SIZE[1], IMAGE_SIZE[0])]
+        ).num_image_tokens[0]
+    )
+    return input_ids, image_tokens
+
+
+def _generate_prompt_tokens(base_url, input_ids, image):
+    resp = requests.post(
+        base_url + "/generate",
+        json={
+            "input_ids": input_ids,
+            "image_data": [image],
+            "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0.0, "max_new_tokens": 1},
+        },
+        timeout=300,
+    )
+    resp.raise_for_status()
+    return resp.json()["meta_info"]["prompt_tokens"]
+
+
+def _chat_prompt_tokens(base_url, input_ids, image):
+    content = [{"type": "text", "text": "Describe the picture: "}]
+    if image is not None:
+        content.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": image}})
+    resp = requests.post(
+        base_url + "/v1/chat/completions",
+        json={
+            "model": "default",
+            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}],
+            "input_ids": input_ids,
+            "max_tokens": 1,
+            "temperature": 0.0,
+        },
+        timeout=300,
+    )
+    resp.raise_for_status()
+    return resp.json()["usage"]["prompt_tokens"]
+
+
+class TestChatInputIdsKeepImages(CustomTestCase):
+    model = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct"
+    image_token = "<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>"
+    other_args = ["--trust-remote-code", "--mem-fraction-static", "0.7"]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=cls.other_args,
+            env={"SGLANG_MM_AVOID_RETOKENIZE": "1"},
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def test_chat_with_input_ids_sees_the_image(self):
+        input_ids, image_tokens = _build_prompt(self.model, self.image_token)
+        image = _data_uri()
+        expected = len(input_ids) - 1 + image_tokens
+
+        via_generate = _generate_prompt_tokens(DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST, input_ids, image)
+        via_chat = _chat_prompt_tokens(DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST, input_ids, image)
+        self.assertEqual(via_generate, expected, "the /generate path is the reference")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            via_chat, expected, f"chat dropped or re-tokenized the image: {via_chat}"
+        )
+
+    def test_chat_with_input_ids_and_no_image_is_unchanged(self):
+        input_ids, _ = _build_prompt(self.model, "")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _chat_prompt_tokens(DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST, input_ids, None), len(input_ids)
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""A pre-tokenized multimodal prompt locates its images by the image
+placeholder id in its ids, never by the regex over its decoded text.
+
+Ordinary tokens that spell the Qwen image regex ("<image>", or the vision
+triple written out) used to count as one more image than image_data held and
+the request failed with "Mismatch: More 'IMAGE' tokens found than
+corresponding data provided". These tests run the loaders with a tokenizer
+whose decode() raises, so a decode is a test failure.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.base_processor import (
+    BaseMultimodalProcessor,
+    MultimodalSpecialTokens,
+)
+
+PAD = 7
+
+
+class _NoDecodeTokenizer:
+    def decode(self, *args, **kwargs):  # pragma: no cover - the assertion
+        raise AssertionError("the decoded text must not be scanned for an ids prompt")
+
+
+def _tokens():
+    return MultimodalSpecialTokens(
+        image_token="<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>",
+        image_token_id=PAD,
+    )
+
+
+class _Processor(BaseMultimodalProcessor):
+    """A BaseMultimodalProcessor shell: only the loader methods run."""
+
+    async def process_mm_data_async(self, *args, **kwargs):  # pragma: no cover
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+def _processor():
+    p = _Processor.__new__(_Processor)
+    p._tokenizer = _NoDecodeTokenizer()
+    p.skip_tokenizer_init = False
+    p.preserve_processor_input_ids = False
+    p.support_dynamic_frame_expansion = False
+    loaded = {}
+
+    async def fast_load_mm_data(prompt, multimodal_tokens, image_data=None, **kw):
+        loaded.update(
+            prompt=prompt, image_data=list(image_data), input_ids=kw.get("input_ids")
+        )
+        return types.SimpleNamespace(**loaded)
+
+    p.fast_load_mm_data = fast_load_mm_data
+    return p, loaded
+
+
+def test_placeholder_layout_prefers_one_id_per_image_then_collapses_runs():
+    f = BaseMultimodalProcessor
+    assert f._placeholder_runs([1, PAD, 2, PAD, PAD, PAD, 3], PAD) == 2
+    assert f._collapse_placeholder_runs([1, PAD, PAD, 2, PAD], PAD) == [1, PAD, 2, PAD]
+    # one id per image, adjacent ids allowed (GLM has no marker between two images)
+    assert f._placeholder_layout([1, PAD, PAD, 2], PAD, 2) == [1, PAD, PAD, 2]
+    # the expanded form: each run is one image
+    assert f._placeholder_layout([1, PAD, PAD, PAD, 2, PAD], PAD, 2) == [1, PAD, 2, PAD]
+    with pytest.raises(
+        ValueError, match=r"carry 3 image placeholder id\(s\) in 1 run\(s\) but 2 image"
+    ):
+        f._placeholder_layout([1, PAD, PAD, PAD], PAD, 2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("loader", ["load_mm_data", "legacy_load_mm_data"])
+def test_an_ids_prompt_with_images_never_decodes(loader):
+    p, loaded = _processor()
+    ids = [1, PAD, 2, 3, PAD, PAD, 4]  # ordinary tokens 2, 3, 4 may spell "<image>"
+    out = asyncio.run(
+        getattr(p, loader)(
+            prompt=ids, multimodal_tokens=_tokens(), image_data=["a.png", "b.png"]
+        )
+    )
+    assert loaded["prompt"] == "<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>" * 2
+    assert loaded["input_ids"] == [1, PAD, 2, 3, PAD, 4]
+    assert loaded["image_data"] == ["a.png", "b.png"]
+    assert out.input_ids == [1, PAD, 2, 3, PAD, 4]
+    assert out.synthetic_text is True, (
+        "a failed expansion must raise, never fall back to this text"
+    )
+
+
+def test_a_placeholder_count_that_differs_from_the_images_is_a_client_error():
+    p, _ = _processor()
+    with pytest.raises(
+        ValueError, match=r"carry 1 image placeholder id\(s\) in 1 run\(s\) but 2 image"
+    ):
+        asyncio.run(
+            p.legacy_load_mm_data(
+                prompt=[1, PAD], multimodal_tokens=_tokens(), image_data=["a", "b"]
+            )
+        )
+
+
+def test_an_ids_prompt_outside_exact_token_mode_keeps_the_text_path(monkeypatch):
+    """With SGLANG_MM_AVOID_RETOKENIZE off the expanded ids would be discarded
+    for the processor's re-tokenization, so the synthetic text must not be
+    used: the old text path runs (here: the tokenizer's decode is reached)."""
+    import sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch as environ_module
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        environ_module.envs.SGLANG_MM_AVOID_RETOKENIZE, "get", lambda: False
+    )
+    p, loaded = _processor()
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="decoded text must not be scanned"):
+        asyncio.run(
+            p.legacy_load_mm_data(
+                prompt=[1, PAD], multimodal_tokens=_tokens(), image_data=["a"]
+            )
+        )
+    assert not loaded
+
+
+def test_text_prompts_video_audio_and_precomputed_features_keep_the_text_path():
+    t = _tokens()
+    f = BaseMultimodalProcessor._ids_for_media
+    assert f("<image> text", None, t, ["a"], None, None) is None
+    assert f([1, PAD], None, t, [], None, None) is None
+    assert f([1, PAD], None, t, ["a"], ["v.mp4"], None) is None
+    assert f([1, PAD], None, t, ["a"], None, ["s.wav"]) is None
+    assert f([1, PAD], None, t, [{"precomputed_features": 1}], None, None) is None
+    assert f([1, PAD], None, t, ["a"], None, None) == [1, PAD]
+    assert f(None, [1, PAD], t, ["a"], None, None) == [1, PAD]
